other: {st:ChargeKhakiAlly} is her Unique Charge and her passive gives her shields and final power based on the Count and Potency respectively.
usage: Applies {st:NoirScissorShield} to allies with her S1 or S3. When the ally attacks an enemy, she follows up with {skill:10917|05}. If the enemy has 2+ {st:NoirScissorAlly}, she follows up with {skill:10917|06} instead, consuming the {st:NoirScissorAlly} and applying {st:NoirScissorCut} which buffs her damage. {st:NoirScissorAlly} is applied by {skill:10917|05} or her S3.

Her S1 targets an ally instead of an enemy and applies additional buffs if the target is a {st:PersonalityCharge}. Her S2 and S3 also buffs allies with additional buffs for {st:PersonalityCharge} allies.
